name: shoulder extension
description: Moving the arm back behind the body, working the lats and rear shoulder.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm straight down at your side.
Swing the arm back behind you, keeping it straight.
Avoid leaning forward, pause, then return to the start.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
